tooltip: Same as "field <name> : <type>", but TYPE is fully free-typed (plain text, no suggestions, no restriction) instead of picked from the registered variable-type dropdown - use this for int/long/float, a custom class, a generic (List<String>), or anything else that isn't one of the registered variable types. A malformed or unresolvable type just fails to compile in the generated mod, same best-effort tradeoff as other free-text enum surfaces in this plugin. Place inside the enum's "fields" section, same as the dropdown variant - mixing both block kinds in the same enum is fine. Not connectable anywhere outside an enum's fields section.
